fields.claim: Material water uses transferred uptakes. The CFRP face uses 0.18%, a pitch/cyanate laminate at 55% RH; other sources give 0.04-0.70% for cyanate and about 0.9% for epoxy. The aramid cores use 95% RH, 120 h pickups (4.4% and 3.4%); the CFRP seam film uses FM-300's 1.67% hot-wet estimate. The bake's 90% removal is 048's acceptance target, and DuPont says Nomex needs at least 100 C to dry fully against 048's 70 C bake.
fields.needed_to_ground: Weighed uptake and bake-out of the chosen face, core and films.
